title: WhatsApp Free Cloud Backup on Android
description: WhatsApp is rolling out a free, built-in cloud backup feature for Android users with encrypted storage. Source: 9to5Google This is a short news summary.
narration: WhatsApp adds free cloud backup for chats. According to 9to5Google, WhatsApp is rolling out a built-in cloud backup feature on Android. The service is free and offers encrypted storage for your chats. An encrypted cloud storage backup option is now available to some beta users on Android. This built-in backup feature is rolling out to Android users at no cost. The update brings a native way to secure your chat history directly through the app. Subscribe for more quick tech updates.
